name: Egypt
dossier:
The Egypt national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the The Pharaohs, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 29 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A pharaoh's last quest: Salah dragging Egypt toward a first knockout stage in the modern era.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Egypt will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group G and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group G. The connection between Mohamed Salah and Omar Marmoush is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Mohamed Salah - the clinical forward who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Egypt are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Mohamed Salah carried Egypt to the 2018 World Cup but injury robbed him of his moment  -  he's back for redemption.
Egypt boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (1934, 1990, 2018).
